title: peltophorum rufum
intro: Peltophorum rufum, commonly known as the Yellow Flame or Yellow Cassia, is a plant species native to Australia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits such as its potential to act as an antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in reducing fever and treating skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Peltophorum rufum include its antioxidant properties, which may help in protecting against cell damage and its potential to aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
